classification: Synthetic engineering scenarios; no operational calendar, approver or deadline policy assigned

scenarios.name: formal_minutes
scenarios.path: meeting source/revision -> decisions and owned actions -> cited minutes -> PMO Lead exact-version review -> internal recipient receipt

scenarios.name: unknown_commitment
scenarios.expected: owner/deadline remain unknown; no zero, invented person or automatic late classification

scenarios.name: source_changes
scenarios.expected: action/meeting changes hold older queued documents; revised sources require a new reviewed document version

scenarios.name: working_calendar
scenarios.expected: configured weekdays, holidays, anchors and units determine a stored deadline with exact policy IDs

scenarios.name: independent_scheduling
scenarios.expected: calendar-day report cadence needs only timezone and that reporting profile; action/holiday rules remain independent

scenarios.name: recurring_preparation
scenarios.expected: atomic PostgreSQL occurrence/cursor produces one draft and human wait, never automatic publication

scenarios.name: clock_lifecycle
scenarios.expected: missing/invalid/stale/revoked/expired values hold dependent clocks only; absolute capture/manual reporting continue

scenarios.name: agent_proposal
scenarios.expected: exact source quotes only, owner/deadline unassigned; separate human commands required
